title: Are LLMs Good Safety Agents or a Propaganda Engine?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring censorship and over-refusal rates by comparing model responses to explicit politically sensitive prompts against implicit (depoliticized) prompts, and applying representation-level concept erasure (LEACE) to evaluate how removing political concepts alters refusal behaviors.

Comparing model refusal and compliance rates across prompts generalized to different national and geopolitical contexts (e.g., USA, France, China, Russia) using statistical analysis (OLS regression) to identify region-specific moderation disparities.
